morphology.pattern_note: 资料包未提供可核实的马来语普通词义，因此不标为 official。以下按英语人名 Hugh 解释；/hjuː/ 是该人名的英语读音，gh 不单独发音，不套用马来语逐字母读法。

senses.zh_definition: 休：英语男性名字 Hugh；此处按专有名词处理，未证实为马来语普通词。
senses.en_definition: Hugh, a masculine given name; not established here as a Malay common word.
senses.ms_definition: Hugh ialah nama khas lelaki dalam bahasa Inggeris; makna sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum disahkan.
senses.nuances: 保留小写检索键 hugh，实际书写人名时用 Hugh。以下组合是人名使用示例，不是已证实的高频词汇搭配；不可将其擅改为 huge 或赋予感叹词义。人名义见 [Oxford Learner's Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/hugh)，读音见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/pronunciation/english/hugh)。

etymology.historical_story: As an English personal name, Hugh comes through medieval French from a Germanic naming element associated with mind or spirit. Its history belongs to European personal naming, rather than Malay word formation. This explains the name only: without its original corpus context, the lowercase packet item cannot confidently be assigned the same identity. [Hugh name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/hugh)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语人名 Hugh 读 /hjuː/，近似“休”；名字首字母大写，末尾 gh 不另读。
